text: Keep that last tile in sight while we rewind. What does it mean to guess the next piece of text? Both models see exactly the same prefix. Each divides a whole bar among possible next tokens. We keep the slice for the word the author actually wrote. It goes on the rail, and the real word slides into place. Even if Blue guessed wrong, its guess never becomes the next prefix. The two models get the same view all the way down.
